html:
Ethiopian Airlines is the state airline of Ethiopia, founded in 1945 by Emperor Haile Selassie. From its hub at Addis Ababa it has grown into the largest airline in Africa.

The emperor wanted a modern national carrier for a country with few roads. He signed a deal with the American airline TWA, which ran the company in its early years while training Ethiopian pilots and managers. Flights began in 1946, to Cairo, and it flew its first jets in 1962. By the 1970s Ethiopians ran it themselves.

Unlike many African state airlines, it stayed well run and profitable through the Derg military government, war and famine. It built a network linking cities all over Africa through Addis Ababa, and on to Europe, the Middle East, Asia and the Americas. It joined the Star Alliance in 2011.

In 2019 its Flight 302 crashed after take-off, killing all 157 people on board. Together with an earlier Indonesian crash, it led to the worldwide grounding of the Boeing 737 MAX.
sum: Ethiopian Airlines is the state airline of Ethiopia, founded in 1945 by Emperor Haile Selassie. From its hub at Addis Ababa it has grown into the largest airline in Africa.
